problems.issue: Relying solely on a Facebook page instead of an official business website
problems.impact: Limits professional credibility, advanced SEO potential, and control over patient booking workflows.

problems.issue: Low social proof and engagement metrics visible in metadata (only 355 followers)
problems.impact: May fail to build sufficient trust with prospective dental patients comparing local clinics.

problems.issue: Lack of structured schema markup for local medical businesses in the HTML
problems.impact: Reduces visibility in local search results and Google Maps listings.

opportunities: Develop a dedicated, mobile-responsive website featuring online appointment scheduling and service pricing.
Implement local SEO strategies and Google Business Profile optimization to capture high-intent 'dentist near me' searches.
Showcase patient testimonials, before-and-after galleries, and dentist credentials prominently to increase conversion rates.
audit.summary: Manila Dental Care Center currently relies exclusively on a Facebook social profile, limiting its digital authority, patient booking capabilities, and local search engine visibility. Establishing a professional, dedicated website with integrated local SEO and booking features will significantly enhance patient acquisition and brand trust.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on Manila Dental Care Center's online presence
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I came across Manila Dental Care Center while looking at local practices and noticed you're currently relying entirely on your Facebook page. Without a dedicated website, it can be tough for new patients to easily book appointments or find you on Google Maps.

We actually put together a quick, live demo of what a professional site and simple booking system could look like for your clinic.

Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---
If you'd prefer not to hear from me again, just reply 'unsubscribe' and I'll remove you right away.
